title: Retail Installment Contracts Delinquency Schedule: Late-Charge Terms and Charge-Off Threshold
content:
The figures below are the same at every credit tier of Retail Installment Contracts.

| Term | Tier 6 Fresh Start | Tier 5 Rebuild | Tier 4 Standard | Tier 3 Advantage | Tier 2 Preferred | Tier 1 Select |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late-charge grace period after an installment due date | 10 calendar days | 10 calendar days | 10 calendar days | 10 calendar days | 10 calendar days | 10 calendar days |
| Late-charge percent of the scheduled installment | 5.0% | 5.0% | 5.0% | 5.0% | 5.0% | 5.0% |
| Largest late charge per installment | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD |
| Late charges per installment due date, at most | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Days past due at which an active contract not assigned for repossession is charged off | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 |

**Notes.**

- The late-charge percent is the product's late-charge percent of 5.0, and the late-charge cap is the product's 25.00 per installment; a figure stated as "the lesser of the percent amount and the cap" is rounded half-up to the cent.
- The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the installment due date.
- The charge-off threshold is counted in days past due, the calendar days from the contract's next due date to the day in question.

**Hypothetical illustration.** With a scheduled installment of 388.60, 5.0% is 19.43, below the 25.00 cap, so the lesser of the two is 19.43. With a scheduled installment of 612.40, 5.0% is 30.62 and the lesser is the 25.00 cap.
